commit_subject: (screen-flagged) b1.6 certify (PR #1300): diff changes the Brazil gate in every generated composition from `not entry_is_line_b` to `not entry_is_section_232_aluminum` and re-grounds the steel parameter proof from 9903.81.87/.88 to 9903.82.02; report says "The task's 9903.81.x locator is stale for this corpus vintage".
description: The generated compositions move from the witness's five per-line exemplar flags to membership-semantic caller inputs, and gain a Section 232 steel component the witness never had.

triage.pre_fix_wrong_because: The Brazil IEEPA 9903.01.77 surcharge was gated off the witness exemplar flag `entry_is_line_b` rather than aluminum membership under 9903.85.02, so Section 232 aluminum entries of Brazilian origin received a 40% add-on the note excludes.
triage.triage_notes: Same pattern as index 60. Chapter-prefixed parameter `ch63_s232_steel_heading_rate`, rate '0.50' unchanged; citation-only re-grounding to 9903.82.02 is the mechanical half of the diff.
triage.verifier_justification: The diff changes encoded meaning in two derived Rate rules (`ieepa_component_rate` at post line 2367 and `ieepa_component_rate_with_declared_exceptions` at 2523): the 9903.01.77 Brazil +40% carve-out stops being gated on the witness exemplar-identity input `entry_is_line_b` and is re-grounded on the membership input `entry_is_section_232_aluminum`. The pinned corpus (release us-rulespec-2026-08-08-obbb-alien-snab, us/statute/hts/chapter-99/page-220) states the carve-out as membership, not line identity: "(vii) The additional duties imposed by heading 9903.01.77 shall not apply to products of aluminum provided for in heading 9903.85.02" — and the module's own proof atom for this branch already quotes that sentence, so the pre-fix condition was a branch with no basis in the cited source, and `entry_is_section_232_aluminum` is a separate caller input (no derived rule aliases it to `entry_is_line_b`), so this is a semantic change, not a rename. Untraceable_branch fits better than wrong_entity_or_scope because the defect is the ungrounded exemplar predicate itself (a harness artifact with no textual referent) being re-grounded on the provision the note names, not a correct predicate pointed at the wrong population.

triage.verifier_notes:
Refutation attempts that failed: (1) "mechanical" — no: formula tokens changed inside two derived Rate rules, not just metadata. (2) "not_a_defect / new coverage" — the composition is generated for every chapter-63 line and (since parent 2a6bdb01d) takes entry flags as caller inputs; the module summary (identical pre and post) already claims "section-232 aluminum/steel ... identifiers are caller inputs", so the leftover `entry_is_line_b` gate contradicted the module's own declared semantics as well as note (vii). (3) "rename" — `entry_is_section_232_aluminum` is an undeclared caller input under the referenced-implies-input convention (used at post 2744/2751), never defined as `entry_is_line_b`.

Caveats for the reviewer: (a) The second half of this diff — `ch63_s232_steel_heading_rate` / `section_232_steel_component_rate` atoms moving from us/statute/hts/9903.81.87 + .88 to 9903.82.02, and the `source:` string — is provenance-only (both versions keep `formula: '0.50'`), i.e. mechanical on its own; my confirmed verdict rests solely on the Brazil gate. (b) That steel re-grounding is not verifiable at this pin: in the release the fix commit's toolchain selects (Rev 3 notes, expression date 2026-02-12) the string 9903.82.02 appears in zero note records, while note (v) on page-220 names 9903.81.87/.88 as the iron/steel exclusion headings; the report's claim "The task's 9903.81.x locator is stale for this corpus vintage" refers to a Rev. 15 vintage not present in the resolvable releases. Worth a separate check. (c) Partial fix: `entry_is_reciprocal_metals_excluded` still has `formula: entry_is_line_b` after this commit (post line 1924), so exemplar-flag grounding remains elsewhere in the same module. (d) The aluminum-exclusion excerpt is attributed in the module to us/statute/hts/chapter-99/page-219, but in the pinned corpus that sentence sits on page-220 (page-219 is a bare HTS-line list) — a provenance mismatch independent of this diff.
